description.message: Keep selected websites active and type your saved text into web page fields with adjustable timing.

action_title_enabled.message: Enabled for $HOST$. Open the popup to control MeowCheats.

action_title_disabled.message: Not enabled for $HOST$. Open the popup to control MeowCheats.

action_title_unknown.message: This tab cannot be handled by this extension. Open a regular http(s) website, such as youtube.com, and click again.

action_title_reload_recommended.message: The changes have been applied to the open tab immediately; reloading the page is recommended to get the full protection.

action_title_reload_required.message: The page is still protected, but reloading the page is required to apply the change.

title_star_note.message: The "*" wildcard in your host list enables this extension on all websites. To change this, visit the options page.

prompt_reload_recommended.message:
The changes have been applied immediately. Reload the page to get the full protection?

If you skip this, some page-level protections may still be missing. You can reload at any time yourself; the R badge is a reminder until then.

prompt_reload_required.message: The tab is still protected, but this host has been removed from the list. Would you like to refresh to apply changes?
